title: RideLink Mileage Taper for Long Trips — Rate Schedule
content:
Non-Emergency Medical Transportation pays the approved miles of a very long trip on a descending scale.

**Rule.** Approved miles are paid on a taper set by their total: when the approved miles are at or under the taper start of 500 miles, every mile is paid at the full per-mile rate; when they are over 500 and at or under the deep taper of 1000 miles, the miles up to 500 are paid at the full rate and the miles above it at the taper share of 0.8 of the rate; when they are over 1000, the miles up to 500 are paid at the full rate, the miles from 500 to 1000 at the taper share of 0.8 and the miles above 1000 at the deep taper share of 0.6. The amount is the tapered miles times the per-mile rate, rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final amount only.

## Schedule

| Band of approved miles | Share of the per-mile rate |
|---|---|
| Miles 0 to 500 | Full rate |
| Miles above 500, up to 1000 | 0.8 of the rate |
| Miles above 1000 | 0.6 of the rate |

The bands apply only to the miles within them: a trip of 600 approved miles pays its first 500 miles in full.

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical approved miles:*

| Approved miles | Tapered miles |
|---|---|
| 500 | 500, all in full |
| 520 | 500 in full and 20 at 0.8, that is 516 |
| 1000 | 500 in full and 500 at 0.8, that is 900 |
| 1200 | 500 in full, 500 at 0.8 (400) and 200 at 0.6 (120), that is 1020 |

*Hypothetical amount:* 1020 tapered miles at a per-mile rate of 0.21 USD give 214.20 USD.
